title: In vitro cell culture models for ultrasound treatments using collagen-based scaffolds
author: Gopalakrishnan, Gupta, et al.
materials: Fisherbrand sterile 12 well plates (used for all cell cultures), Gibco rat tail collagen 1 solution (concentration 3mg/mL) and phosphate buffer saline (PBS) were purchased from Fisher Scientific. Deionized water produced by a Millipore System (MilliQ water) was utilized post sterilization by autoclaving. All procedures were performed under sterile conditions in a BSL 2 facility inside a biosafety cabinet.
Step 2: Fibroblast culture on 2D collagen films

Step 2: Cell culture and cell counting.
1.Once the cells were 80-90% confluent, the growth medium was removed and washed with PBS.2.The cells were then trypsinized with ∼3mL of 0.05 % Trypsin-EDTA and incubated at 37°C for 5-7 mins to allow the cells to detach.3.Once the cells were detached, 7mL of complete medium was added to neutralize the trypsin.4.The cell solution was then collected in a 15mL Falcon tube and centrifuged at 3000rpm for 5 minutes to collect the cell pellet.5.The growth medium was removed without disturbing the pellet and resuspended with fresh complete growth medium accordingly.6.10uL of cell solution was taken in an Eppendorf tube and mixed with 10uL of trypan blue. 10uL of this mixture was then added to one side of the disposable cell counting chamber slide and inserted into the Invitrogen Countess II Automated Cell Counter machine to count the number of cells in the cell solution.

Fisherbrand sterile 12 well plates (used for all cell cultures) and phosphate buffer saline (PBS) were purchased from Fisher Scientific. Deionized water produced by a Millipore System (MilliQ water) was utilized post sterilization by autoclaving. Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS) was purchased from Peak Serum. Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium 1x (DMEM) with 4.5 g/L D-Glucose, L-Glutamine and 110 mg/L Sodium Pyruvate was purchased from Fisher Scientific. HEPES solution was purchased from Millipore Sigma. Penicillin and Streptomycin (P/S) were purchased from Invitrogen. Bovine tendon type I collagen was purchased from Organogenesis. Minimum essential medium with Earle's salts (MEM 10x), L-glutamine and sodium bicarbonate was purchased from Cambrex. All reagents were utilized as obtained from the vendor without additional purification, unless otherwise specified. All procedures were performed under sterile conditions in a BSL 2 facility inside a biosafety cabinet.
The Invitrogen alamarBlue dye was purchased from Fisher Scientific. Fluorescence signal was measured on a SpectraMax M2 plate reader from Molecular Devices.

steps.title: Prepare 2D collagen coatings
steps.instruction: In a BSL‑2 biosafety cabinet, dilute Gibco rat‑tail collagen I (3 mg/mL) with sterile MilliQ water to 1 mg/mL; add 1 mL of this solution to each well of a sterile 12‑well plate (leave desired wells empty for controls); incubate 30 min at 37 °C; discard excess solution and wash each coated well three times with PBS; use plates immediately for cell culture.

steps.title: Thaw NIH‑3T3 cells
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw ~1 mL frozen NIH‑3T3 stock (<1 min) in a 37 °C water bath; add 9 mL pre‑warmed complete DMEM (10 % v/v FBS, 1 % v/v pen‑strep) to dilute; centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 5 min; remove supernatant without disturbing pellet; resuspend cells in 9 mL fresh complete medium; transfer the suspension to a T‑75 flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 80‑90 % confluent.

steps.title: Count and dilute cells for plating
steps.instruction: When cultures reach 80‑90 % confluence, aspirate medium, wash with PBS, add ~3 mL 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 5‑7 min at 37 °C; neutralize with 7 mL complete medium; transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge 3000 rpm for 5 min; remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in fresh complete medium; mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, load 10 µL of the mixture into a Countess II chamber slide and determine cell concentration; dilute the cell suspension to 1 × 10⁵ cells per well for plating.

steps.title: Plate cells on 2D wells
steps.instruction: Add 100 000 cells in 1 mL of complete medium to each uncoated or collagen‑coated well of a 12‑well plate; incubate overnight at 37 °C, humidified 5 % CO₂; the next day the plates are ready for ultrasound treatment.

steps.title: Split remaining cells
steps.instruction: Take the leftover cell suspension, split 1:10 into a new T‑75 flask, and sub‑culture every 2 days for future experiments.

steps.title: Prepare 3D gel components (24 h prior)
steps.instruction: Make conditioned DMEM by mixing 1× DMEM with 10 % FBS, 1 % pen‑strep, and 1 % HEPES under sterile conditions; store at 4 °C together with FBS, L‑glutamine, DMEM, 1 M NaHCO₃, pipette tips (p1000, p200), 15 mL Falcon tubes, and sterile 12‑well plates; sterilize 1 M NaHCO₃ by filtering through a 0.22 µm PTFE syringe filter; autoclave forceps.

steps.title: Generate cell‑seeding suspension
steps.instruction: When NIH‑3T3 cultures are 80‑90 % confluent, aspirate medium and add 5 mL PBS warmed to 37 °C; swirl gently, discard PBS; add 2 mL 0.05 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 8‑10 min at 37 °C; add ~6 mL conditioned DMEM to neutralize; transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C; remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 15 mL fresh complete medium; take 10 µL of this suspension, add 40 µL fresh DMEM and 50 µL trypan blue in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, mix, load 10 µL on a hemocytometer and count; finally, prepare 3.22 mL of cell‑seeding solution at 3 × 10⁵ cells/mL.

steps.title: Cast 3D collagen gels
steps.instruction: Place cell‑seeding solution, complete medium, two 50 mL Falcon tubes, collagen I solution (Organogenesis), sterile NaHCO₃ solution, 12‑well plates, and transfer pipettes on ice; keep all components cold. In Tube 1 (cell‑laden) combine per Table 1: 3.5 mL 10× MEM, 316 µL L‑glutamine, 3.92 mL FBS, 1089 µL NaHCO₃, 29.17 mL collagen I, then add 3.22 mL cell‑seeding suspension; mix by pipetting back‑and‑forth until straw‑yellow (add NaHCO₃ in 80 µL increments if lighter). Dispense 2 mL of this mixture into each well of a 12‑well plate (≈18 gels). In Tube 2 (cell‑free control) combine 0.875 mL 10× MEM, 79 µL L‑glutamine, 980 µL FBS, 273 µL NaHCO₃, 7.3 mL collagen I, then add 804 µL DMEM; mix and dispense 2 mL per well (≈4 gels). Incubate plates at 37 °C, 7.5 % CO₂ for 1 h to gel; pink colour indicates firm gels. Feed gels with 2 mL warm complete medium every other day for 7 days before ultrasound.

steps.title: Perform ultrasound treatment
steps.instruction: Using a VCX‑130 vibracell processor with 6 mm probe set to 35 % amplitude, ensure each well (2D or 3D) contains a final volume of 2 mL medium; lower the probe to 1‑2 mm depth at the centre of the well; apply ultrasound for 75 s, 150 s, or 300 s; repeat each condition in at least three separate wells; keep at least three wells per culture untreated as negative controls; also treat uncoated 12‑well plates with the same three durations as positive controls.

steps.title: Assess viability with alamarBlue
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer’s planktonic‑cell protocol: add 200 µL alamarBlue to each 12‑well culture well, pipette gently to mix, and incubate 3 h at 37 °C. In parallel, prepare a reference: fill six wells of a black 96‑well plate with 100 µL the same DMEM used for culture plus 10 µL alamarBlue; incubate 3 h at 37 °C. After incubation, withdraw 330 µL supernatant from each 12‑well well and dispense into three separate 96‑well wells (110 µL each) containing the reference solution, giving three technical replicates per well. Measure fluorescence (excitation 560 nm, emission 590 nm). Calculate % viability: %Viability = [(F_treated – F_reference) / (F_untreated – F_reference)] × 100. Average the nine technical replicates (3 wells × 3 repeats) per treatment and compute standard deviation; repeat the entire assay two additional times for reproducibility.
